scope: Offline feasibility and baseline evaluation; optional captured model outputs. No API calls or simulated games are made by this command.

fixtures.prices: Synthetic, 10 SEK per copy except declared expensive/unknown cases; shipping excluded

baseline.note: Exact reference is owned; assess whether generation preserves its coherent strategy.

feasibility.assumptions: Advisory package costs from confirmed holdings and missing copies only; shipping excluded. Each package uses one actual reference, never pooled quantities across strategies. Reference-ready covers the full list including its sideboard. Core-ready covers reviewed engine quantities, Legend, chosen champion and requested favourites, not the remaining deck. Minimum package uses one copy of each annotated engine card and is only an optimistic floor, not a playable engine. Core annotations are incomplete; needs-review strategies remain eligible. Core gaps can sometimes be resolved by reviewed reductions or a different strategy. No affordability status establishes competitive strength.

baseline.note: One reference copy costs exactly 10 SEK; owned-only requires a real substitution. For unreviewed strategies its flexibility still needs review.

limitations: Controlled baselines are copied references, not generated AI decks.
Passing validation or feasibility tests does not establish strategic quality.
Unknown core roles remain unreviewed; annotations are judgments, not proofs.
Human rubric fields require independent review; this command does not certify them.
The benchmark uses frozen local rule/card data, not a live rules verification.
Captured provider failures must be included. Declared costs are metadata, not independently verified billing.
